medium.prompt: Edit the bed component. For low battery do NOT use a red outline or border around the whole battery icon: retain the normal neutral metal/cyan thin outline; ONLY the individual lit segment itself emits red light. Preserve bed shape, position, scale, canvas, perspective, bedding and all OTHER decorative strips unchanged. Genuine transparent PNG.
